title: Motion
settingsHelp: Property selects what moves; From/To sets its range. Period is the cycle duration. Direct follows immediately, Smooth eases movement, Rebound adds overshoot. Click can pulse or toggle; drag can return or hold. Settings apply when you select a behavior. Test is temporary; Record moves the active behaviors into editable timeline blocks.
padHint: Move here or on the canvas
pointerXYHint: Follow the pointer in both directions
help: Record here to preserve editor controls. Move or drag; use Enter for primary click, Shift+Enter for secondary click, or arrows to move. Escape cancels.
full: Recording limit reached. Try a shorter take.
failed: The animation could not be added.
unavailable: Select an effect in the current composition.
